project_name: Guam Power Authority 20 MW Aggreko temporary power after Typhoon Mawar
owner_or_developer: Guam Power Authority (GPA), governed by the Consolidated Commission on Utilities (CCU)
selection_note: Chosen as a post-typhoon emergency capacity case with a named rental vendor and regulator/AG approvals. Hindsight-selected development case after the outcome was known; not a sealed holdout; not independently cited.

blockers: Only one precursor signal and its timestamp is unproven (UNKNOWN); the OPA document concerns the Yigo Diesel repair bid GPA-023-23, not the Aggreko rental, so it evidences capacity need, not the rental procurement itself.
Target is a trade-press article with no printed date in the capture; Wayback snapshot (2024-03-03) is about 6 weeks after the Jan 23 2024 CCU meeting.
Official CCU resolutions (FY2024-16, FY2024-11), GPA IFB/RFP documents and the PUC docket were not retrievable (guamccu.org agenda PDF returned 404 / unparseable via capture).
Procurement history in secondary search results: an earlier 2023 temporary-power bid was protested and cancelled, then emergency procurement under Bill 206; not captured.
AG/PUC approval (about Mar 28 2024) article exists but was not kept as a signal.

The captured OPA reply concerns Multi-Step Bid GPA-023-23 (restoration of existing Yigo Diesel units), not the Aggreko rental; no tender or RFP document for the Aggreko award was captured, so the award is the earliest procurement-type event only because nothing earlier was found.
reviewer_checklist: Find CCU/GPA resolution FY2024-16 text and the PUC docket for the petition; capture with docket stamps.
Establish the earliest dated public signal (Typhoon Mawar damage statement, Sept 2023 CCU authorization) with provable timestamps.
Confirm the Jan 23 2024 CCU approval date from an official source.
target_fit_note: Emergency 20 MW temporary-power contract awarded to Aggreko to be delivered within 100 days; the same article calls the projects a short-term bridge until the Ukudu plant is commissioned, so this is a genuine temporary/rental award, but only the award (not the tender) is visible.
